examples.input:
A circuit with 12V and 6V batteries and resistances \SI{2}{\ohm}, \SI{4}{\ohm} forms a loop in the following order if we start from Point A in clockwise. Point A , \SI{6}{\ohm} , \SI{4}{\ohm}, Point B,  \SI{2}{\ohm}, \SI{12}{\ohm} cell. What is the potential difference VA - VB in this network?

Options:
1. 10 V
2. 8 V
3. 6 V
4. Zero
